title: Missing moeb tool: github_releases (not exposed in MCP session)
description: Used WebFetch to perform GitHub Releases API queries and action.yml inspection because github_releases was not available in the MCP tool schema for this session. The tool is implemented in Rust source (src/moeb/src/tools/github_releases.rs) but was not exposed by the running MCP server. WebFetch was used to call https://api.github.com/repos/{repo}/releases?per_page=30 and https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{repo}/{tag}/action.yml for actions/checkout, actions/cache, and softprops/action-gh-release.
proposed_resolution: Restart the Claude Code MCP extension with the latest compiled moeb binary so that github_releases appears in the MCP tool schema. No new moeb tool is needed — the tool already exists.
